entities.external_name: the black satin and lace product display
entities.starting_state: motionless in the opening three-quarter composition

identity: black satin and lace product-only display object
no human body, face, skin, hand, or wearer
product_or_prop: same garment construction, strap geometry, lace edge, hardware, and proportions throughout
scene: dark studio, smoky mirror, black reflective floor, stable camera axis
composition_axis: vertical 9:16, clean central product read, negative space for post copy at the end
palette_material: black, deep burgundy accent, restrained neutral reflections
lens_grammar: controlled product cinematography; one main camera move per shot
audio_spine: no dialogue or voiceover; tactile foley and low mechanical room tone only

composition.visual_center: The product silhouette and the satin highlight are the first read; the mirror echo is secondary.
composition.subject_hierarchy: Product first, material detail second, mirror reflection third, environment last.
composition.foreground_midground_background: Foreground: controlled edge reflection; midground: product-only display object; background: smoky mirror and dark studio.
composition.negative_space: Preserve clean lower-right and final-side space for post-production copy; keep the product away from the crop edge.
composition.movement_room: Leave lateral room for the 45-degree turn and a small camera pull-back without cropping the silhouette.
composition.leading_lines_occlusion_parallax: Use mirror edge and floor reflection as leading lines; one controlled foreground reflection may briefly mask the transition.
composition.balance_symmetry: Start nearly centered and stable; shift to a restrained three-quarter asymmetry only when the object turn begins.
composition.perspective_depth: Shallow but readable depth; mirror reflection recedes behind the product and never becomes a second subject.
composition.screen_direction: Turn and camera travel preserve the same left-to-right spatial logic.
composition.narrative_purpose: Move from controlled identity to material discovery to a confident final reveal.

lighting.condition: Dark studio with a narrow deep-burgundy edge source entering from camera-left and a soft neutral fill at low level.
lighting.effect: Separate the black satin from the background while preserving lace texture and mirror depth.

optics.condition: A practical highlight may graze the lens edge during the material reveal.
optics.physical_behavior: Very soft local bloom and restrained veiling glare only at the edge highlight; no full-frame wash, no fake horizontal streak.

atmosphere.condition: Sparse haze is visible only where the edge light crosses the dark studio air.
atmosphere.density_scale: low density, large-scale studio depth; never opaque
atmosphere.light_path_visibility: short, soft directional falloff; no generic god rays
atmosphere.movement: almost static, with only imperceptible air drift

grade.condition: Neutral balance first, then a controlled dark fashion grade.
grade.white_balance_anchor: neutral black and neutral mirror reflection before the burgundy accent
grade.contrast_gamma: moderate contrast with lifted shadow separation, not crushed blacks
grade.black_level: deep but textured; retain satin and lace detail
grade.highlight_rolloff: soft roll-off on satin highlights and mirror reflections
grade.saturation_density: low overall saturation with dense black and restrained burgundy
grade.palette_separation: burgundy edge light separated from neutral-black product body
grade.grain_halation: very fine grain and only local highlight halation if the edge practical triggers it

render_look.exit_or_continuity: Edge bloom and haze remain subtle through the reveal and fall back before the final clean hold; grade stays continuous across all shots.

shot_blocks.emotional_or_attention_beat: quiet certainty; the eye settles on the silhouette

entity_actions.initial_state: motionless in the opening three-quarter composition
entity_actions.trigger: the camera begins its restrained move
entity_actions.path: remain physically still while the viewing angle changes
entity_actions.physical_consequence: the satin highlight shifts slightly without changing geometry
entity_actions.final_state: the silhouette and satin highlight are clearly readable

subject_action.initial_state: Product-only display object is still in the opening three-quarter composition.
subject_action.trigger: The first low mechanical pulse begins.
subject_action.path: No subject travel; only a minimal natural fabric settle.
subject_action.final_state: Silhouette and satin highlight are clearly readable.

object_action.initial_state: Display object and product are stable.
object_action.physical_consequence: Satin highlight shifts slightly with the camera angle.

environment_action.initial_state: Dark mirror studio with stable reflection.
environment_action.response: A restrained burgundy edge reflection breathes at low intensity.
environment_action.final_state: Mirror and floor remain spatially consistent.

camera.angle_height_axis: eye-level display-object height, three-quarter angle, axis locked
camera.lens_feel_reason: normal product perspective with enough depth for mirror geometry; avoid wide-angle distortion
camera.end_target: satin highlight and upper lace edge
camera.speed_easing: near-static start, gentle ease-in, no acceleration spike
camera.focus: hold silhouette, then settle on satin highlight without a visible focus hunt
camera.motivation: invite attention and establish material before the reveal

shot_blocks.composition_state: Centered, stable, controlled negative space; product is the dominant read.
shot_blocks.look_delta: Local edge bloom is inactive unless the practical highlight crosses the lens edge.
shot_blocks.transition_in: Opening hold from black with no graphic overlay.
shot_blocks.transition_out: Specular match cut on the satin highlight into S02.

shot_blocks.emotional_or_attention_beat: curiosity moves from silhouette to tactile detail

entity_actions.initial_state: fixed in the same orientation and construction
entity_actions.trigger: the lateral camera move reaches the material plane
entity_actions.path: remain still while reflections travel from satin to lace and hardware
entity_actions.physical_consequence: satin reflection changes continuously while lace stays matte
entity_actions.final_state: lace edge, strap, satin weave, and hardware remain legible and unchanged

subject_action.initial_state: Product remains the same object and orientation.
subject_action.trigger: Specular highlight bridges into the close view.
subject_action.path: No garment redesign; only the camera reveals the surface.
subject_action.final_state: Lace edge, strap, satin weave, and hardware are legible.

object_action.path: Hardware remains fixed while reflections travel across the surface.
object_action.physical_consequence: Satin reflection changes continuously; lace remains matte and textured.
object_action.final_state: No new parts, no missing parts, no morphing.

environment_action.initial_state: Mirror reflection stays behind the material detail.
environment_action.response: A soft practical reflection enters the far edge and produces a small controlled highlight response.
environment_action.final_state: The light exits before it can wash the frame.

camera.angle_height_axis: slightly below material plane, axis parallel to the product edge
camera.lens_feel_reason: macro-like compression for texture separation without distorting hardware
camera.path: slow 12-centimeter lateral glide from satin to lace edge and hardware
camera.end_target: single metal detail at the moment of the sound tick
camera.speed_easing: constant, tactile, no whip or orbit
camera.focus: one deliberate rack from satin to lace/hardware around 04.20
camera.motivation: turn the viewer's attention into material proof

shot_blocks.composition_state: Asymmetrical material frame with foreground reflection as a controlled edge layer; no subject crop.
shot_blocks.look_delta: Subtle diffusion and local halation appear only at the edge practical; bokeh is small and tied to two distant point lights.
shot_blocks.transition_out: Rack-focus bridge from hardware highlight back to the full silhouette.

shot_blocks.emotional_or_attention_beat: the controlled object becomes a resolved hero image

entity_actions.initial_state: stable in the established three-quarter state
entity_actions.path: rotate once around the vertical axis by approximately 45 degrees with gentle ease-in and no wobble
entity_actions.physical_consequence: mirror and floor reflections track the same rotation
entity_actions.final_state: settled in the final three-quarter composition before the clean hold

subject_action.initial_state: Product-only display object is in the established three-quarter state.
subject_action.path: Rotate the display object around its vertical axis approximately 45 degrees, smooth and mechanically plausible.
subject_action.final_state: Final three-quarter angle closely matches the end-composition target and holds for 01.20 seconds.

object_action.path: One continuous vertical-axis rotation; no wobble, no extra rotation, no part separation.
object_action.physical_consequence: Mirror reflection and satin highlight track the rotation; floor reflection shifts with the same geometry.
object_action.final_state: Object settles completely before the final hold.

environment_action.response: Reflection follows the object while the haze remains low density; no new rays or particles appear.
environment_action.final_state: Clean dark negative space remains available for post copy.

camera.angle_height_axis: eye-level display-object height, same axis and horizon as the opening shot
camera.lens_feel_reason: normal perspective keeps proportions stable during the 45-degree turn
camera.support: locked-off camera with a small controlled pull-back
camera.path: begin locked, then ease into a 15-centimeter pull-back while the object turns
camera.end_target: final silhouette with clean negative space
camera.speed_easing: slow motor ease-in, constant middle, soft ease-out before 08.80
camera.focus: hold the product sharp; no focus shift during the turn
camera.motivation: reveal the resolved angle and create a post-copy-safe ending

shot_blocks.composition_state: Shift from centered stability to restrained three-quarter asymmetry; preserve safe negative space and full silhouette.
shot_blocks.look_delta: No new filter; edge glow recedes by 08.80 and the grade returns to a clean textured hold.
audio_cues: subtle stereo movement following the turntable
audio tail falls toward silence from 08.80
shot_blocks.transition_in: Rack-focus bridge into the full product silhouette.
shot_blocks.transition_out: Clean hold to post-production copy; no generated text.
